articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's New Album Is So Big, Even a 50-Year Rock Legend Got His First Solo Hit!
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo's third album just smashed records, with all 13 songs landing in the top 30. Even Robert Smith from The Cure got his first solo hit from it—at age 66! Imagine your grandma's favorite band suddenly charting because of a 23-year-old pop star.

articles.title: What If Elephants Had Won? The Podcast That Imagines a World Where Rome Lost
articles.summary: A new podcast asks: what if Carthage beat Rome? Hannibal and his elephants almost crushed the Roman Republic. Historians imagine how our world might look today—maybe we'd all be speaking a different language and eating different food.

articles.title: When It Gets Too Hot, Even Monkey Moms Say 'I Can't Do This Anymore'
articles.summary: Scientists saw something heartbreaking during a bad drought: capuchin monkey mothers abandoning their crying babies. New research shows extreme weather is messing up monkey groups—making food fights worse and changing how they share the forest.
